title: Sentry User auth token: benign near miss controls
summary: 2 inputs holding near-miss values that resemble the format but break it (truncated, wrong separator, wrong prefix or too short).
rationale: Incomplete or malformed values are not issued credentials. They test whether the format's structure, and not only its look, is what identifies a credential.

expectation.rationale: Legacy tier T2 (tool-corroborated), but the cited sources do not include artifacts from two distinct owners, so the corroboration rule of docs/governance/evidence-classes.md is not met; the legacy expectation is recorded as project-policy pending review. Malformed-by-construction control: prefix-only, truncated, mis-delimited or public-material shape of a contracted family. Expected silence follows from construction.
